text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I was about to start our usual training
with Bamboo Memory, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Give me another fiery training session today, please!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh?
There's a crowd gathering near the track...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
That was fantastic just now!
I got a great shot of your expression!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...No, there are still a few things I'm not satisfied with, so if possible, could we go for one more lap, please?!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Yes, understood. Don't worry.
Now then, why don't we fix up your makeup first?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like an interview of some kind!
Yaeno's been getting a lot of attention lately, after all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I run with Yaeno all the time! We always get totally fired up, so it's the absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So I totally get why reporters would wanna interview Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir! I'll do my best!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "...Still, Yaeno's running seemed off compared to usual—lacking its usual sharpness, or maybe its fire—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: She doesn't really look like her usual self, su.
choice_data_list: Maybe it feels different on race day compared to a shoot.
Maybe it feels different on race day compared to a shoot, you know?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Feelings...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I've got a great idea, su!
Excuse me for a moment!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: I think this is a great photo too, though...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm still falling just short.
I'm sorry, could we please go one more time!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You're lacking passion, Yaenooo!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san?!
Wh-What is that outfit...?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, if you wanna get hyped up, it's gotta be this!
A Racing Racewear packed full of 'dreams'!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to have heated battles with my rivals—
Dreaming of that very stage, Trainer and I
designed this racing outfit together.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Look, check it out! There's literally
dreams sewn into the hem right here!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Was it a dream?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Exactly! To me, a racing outfit is a ticket to my dreams!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Yaeno, get up on stage too!
I'll fire ya right up!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
! ...You're right.
Bamboo-san, please run with me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
carrying that momentum, the two ran side-by-side...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
That was fantastic!
The fiery determination in both your expressions to win!
It made for the ultimate shot!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see the finished prints, either! Well then, I'll take my leave now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Um, Bamboo-san!
Thank you for all your help today. As for my thanks—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm good for now, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh... Why?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'll repay you on the racetrack someday!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh...... Yes!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
Having rivals really is the best!
choice_data_list: A race between those two is going to be intense.
A race between those two is going to be intense.
Do you feel confident you'll win?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
Having rivals really is the best!
choice_data_list: A race between those two is going to be intense.
A race between those two is going to be intense.
Do you feel confident you'll win?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
How could I not get fired up about this?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright! To win,
I gotta give it my all in training!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah, I can't wait starting right now!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After this incident, Bamboo Memory threw herself into training harder than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wha-?! You think I can't win?!
choice_data_list: I just wanted to make my intentions clear.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, gotcha!
Putting it into words definitely helps
tighten one's focus, too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! I am definitely
going to win against my rival, for sure!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Bamboo Memory made that vow,
her expression was utterly earnest and direct.
